image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a natural substrate of soil, pine needles, and small rocks. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and stripes. Its head is visible with small dark eyes, and its short limbs are positioned on the ground. The tail extends behind the body, tapering to a point.
